proves.claim: A prepared write under captureBoardChanges yields the same relay changeset as the equivalent logEvent write on a real SQLite board.

store.io-board-write-sequencer.envelope-.why: A prepared move that skipped capture would reach the relay as no changeset, so no move can migrate until the envelope is shared.

proves.claim: commitPrepared applies the same write policy and review normalization as logEvent, and a policy-refused write appends nothing.

store.io-board-write-sequencer.envelope-.why: The prepared path must not bypass a landed write policy or review defaults that every logEvent write honours.
